lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\LibreFinanceNfse\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: lib/Service/DraftService.php:92 OCP\IDBConnection::lastInsertId(): deprecated since Nextcloud 21; use \OCP\DB\QueryBuilder\IQueryBuilder::getLastInsertId
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 36. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Service/DraftService.php:92 OCP\IDBConnection::lastInsertId(): deprecated since Nextcloud 21; use \OCP\DB\QueryBuilder\IQueryBuilder::getLastInsertId

1 transaction is opened and closed by hand. The trait TTransactional has atomic() since Nextcloud 24 and atomicRetry() since Nextcloud 27, which repeats a transaction that ran into a deadlock, as the manual recommends.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
